assertionsForPort: Hostile royalist attacks are not a one-shot pre-battle event. After battle resolution, main:L4C50 jumps to main:L487E, active owner 0 jumps to $3009, and $3009 enters kampf:L8461 again.
A resolved hostile royalist battle can therefore trigger another royalist attack before returning to the normal player loop.
The repeated attack uses the same normal battle resolution and map-capture code as player and computer-baron attacks.
L8C34 is part of post-battle logic and must not be removed: when the captured target has fortification, it decrements the target fortification before capture-side bookkeeping.

The visual battle-screen routines patched in this fixture are rendering or delay paths only; source selection, threshold check, casualty calculation, map capture, C832 spent markers, and L4C50 repeat dispatch remain live.
